statement.p: Find the equation of the tangent plane to z = e^{x}+y+y^{5}+9 at the point (0, 4, 1038).

static.solution: z = e^{x}+y+y^{5}+9. The partial derivatives are {\partial z\over\partial x}\bigg|_{(x,y) = (0,4)} = e^{x}\bigg|_{(x,y)=(0,4)} = 1, and {\partial z\over\partial y}\bigg|_{(x,y) = (0,4)} = 1+5y^{4}\bigg|_{(x,y)=(0,4)} = 1281. So the equation of the tangent plane is z = 1038 + 1(x - 0) + 1281(y - 4) = 1038+x+1281\mathopen{}\left(y-4\right).
